rec.name: PDP Social Proof & Rating Banner
rec.status: Built — launched (customer-approved after two rounds of spacing feedback)

what.text: A compact banner block placed directly above the product title on the PDP, with two switchable types. 'Social' shows up to 5 overlapping round avatars next to an influencer/name line plus a social proof sentence, e.g. 'matiamu and 63,000 others are thrilled by us', with an optional Instagram verified checkmark. 'Rating' shows a review sentence with star icons, e.g. '18,386+ customers rated us 5 stars ★★★★★', where the '(rating)' placeholder in the text is replaced by star icons.

why.text: Placing the proof right at the top of the buy box, before the title and price, builds trust early. The Social variant uses real faces, a named influencer and a large audience number (bandwagon effect, authority/familiarity). The Rating variant uses a concrete review count and a 5-star score as quantified proof, which reduces perceived purchase risk.

how.text: Build a custom Shopify theme block (named 'CRO | Social Proof') for the product information section, positioned above the title. A 'Type' switch (Social / Rating) controls which fields are shown. Social: upload up to 5 avatar images, enter the influencer name(s), toggle the Instagram checkmark, enter rich text content and optionally bold it. Rating: enter rich text with the '(rating)' token, which the Liquid/JS replaces with the star icons in the rating color. Style options cover colors, border and rounded/corners shape. Spacing and font size are set separately for desktop and mobile. Text fields can be dynamic-source enabled (database icon), which suggests metafield support. The name and the text are separate fields, so avoid extra whitespace between them (a customer-reported bug).

items: Rating banner text with '(rating)' placeholder for stars
Mobile settings: font size, space top, space bottom

dependencies.text: Custom theme block in a Shopify OS 2 product template. Avatar images must be uploaded to the theme editor. The database icons next to the text fields indicate dynamic source/metafield support (inferred, not confirmed). No app required as far as shown. Real, verifiable review counts and the influencer's consent are needed for the content.
